text:
there is nothing to

discuss

there is nothing to

remember

there is nothing to

forget

it is sad

and

it is not

sad

it seems that the

most

sensible

thing a person can

do

is

sit

with a glass in

hand

translation.title: The Best of the Breed
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the stripped-down movement from negation to sitting with a drink.
